U2: Document Kryo optimization guidelines for end-users.
U3: Upgrade to Kafka 0.8.2 to leverage latest features and test performance.
U4: Create a Tuple load-generator to measure Tuple based payload performance.
U5: Create a new load-generator for highly optimized (kryo serialized) payload to measure performance differences.
U6: Rerun baseline, Tuple, and Serialized payloads to compare performance between Kafka 0.8.1 and 0.8.2.
U7: Document performance benchmark results with infrastructure specifics for a blog.
U8: Study state management requirements to brainstorm design for native stateful stream processing support in XD.

2. Refactor Tuple to remove/adjust ID and TimeStamp for performance (U1)
3. Write Kryo optimization guidelines documentation (U2)
4. Upgrade Kafka dependency to 0.8.2 (U3)
5. Test Kafka 0.8.2 integration and performance (U3)
6. Develop Tuple load-generator (U4)
7. Develop Kryo serialized payload load-generator (U5)

11. Study state management requirements for stateful stream processing (U8)
12. Brainstorm and design stateful stream processing support (U8)

- The team is familiar with Spring XD, Kafka, Kryo, and performance testing.
- The codebase is modular and the Tuple class is well-isolated.
- Kafka upgrade is a minor version upgrade (0.8.1 to 0.8.2) so likely minimal breaking changes.
- Load generators are new tools, not part of the main product, so they can be simpler.
- Benchmarking environment is already set up.
- Documentation is in markdown or similar.
- State management study is a research/design activity, not implementation.

Technical and design decisions:
- Use existing benchmarking framework for load generators.
- Kryo serialization will be used for optimized payload.
- Kafka upgrade will be done by updating dependency and fixing any compilation issues.
- Performance benchmarks will be run on a dedicated cluster with same infrastructure for both versions.
- State management design will be documented as a proposal.

2. Refactor Tuple: 2 days (including testing)
3. Write Kryo optimization guidelines: 1.5 days
4. Upgrade Kafka dependency: 0.5 day (just update version and resolve any conflicts)
5. Test Kafka 0.8.2 integration and performance: 1 day (run existing tests, maybe some new tests)

7. Develop Kryo serialized payload load-generator: 2 days (similar but with Kryo)
8. Run performance benchmarks: 2 days (setup, run multiple iterations, collect data)
9. Compare and analyze benchmark results: 1 day
10. Document benchmark results and infrastructure: 1.5 days
11. Study state management requirements: 2 days (research, meetings)
12. Brainstorm and design stateful stream processing: 3 days (design docs, diagrams, review)

Total = 1+2+1.5+0.5+1+2+2+2+1+1.5+2+3 = 19.5 days.
